svg.title: SwinIR family
svg.desc: RGB super-resolution ×4,input3 × 64 × 64,native eval. Shapes exclude batch.
svg.text: RGB super-resolution ×4,input3 × 64 × 64,native eval. Shapes exclude batch.

g.data-description: Six Swin blocks/group; A heads; window8
g.text: Six Swin blocks/group; A heads; window8
No spatial downsampling or patch merging inside RSTB.
Initial patch embed has LayerNorm; RSTB re-embed does not.
No input-image residual in these registered SR presets.

g.data-description: Shift4 on odd blocks;0 on even blocks
g.text: Shift4 on odd blocks;0 on even blocks

g.aria-label: Reverse windows and undo cyclic shift
g.data-label: Reverse windows and undo cyclic shift
g.text: Reverse windows and undo cyclic shift
Dropout/DropPath are identities in eval. No absolute positions.

g.data-description: 0 within region, -100 across artificial wrap boundary
g.text: 0 within region, -100 across artificial wrap boundary
V is the value slice of the same QKV projection; it bypasses QK/bias/mask.
Same module choice in every RSTB and after the full body.
M/L use two nearest×2 resize/conv stages.
All windows are8×8 withshift4 in alternating blocks.
Family view shows structural alternatives, not width-only scaling.
Source: libreyolo/models/swinir/nn.py and model.py. Revision a4d0ecc9e17f.
